name: concurrent-conflicting-approvals
invariant: Of concurrent confirmations, rejections and expiries of one proposal exactly one applies, the others stale in the writer; independently, authority refuses a proposal no longer open, directly and through commands at its new version, and a confirmation at expiry, writing nothing (03 "The writer"; 04 "Proposals and confirmation"). M0 has no proposal.confirm command wired to the writer: the fixture's command calls authority in the transaction.
